newsitem.title: USA: Lawyers for NASD whistleblower worked for group.
newsitem.headline: Lawyers for NASD whistleblower worked for group.

text.p: Lawyers for Theresa Carr, the former National Association of Securities Dealers muni examiner who is suing the association for harassment, are no strangers to the workings of NASD.

Two partners at the small New York City firm of Singer Zamansky L.L.P. are former NASD lawyers, including Bill Singer, who was an attorney in the association's District 10 office in Manhattan from 1986 to 1988, a spokesman for the firm told Reuters Friday.
And partner Franklin Ogely was a senior examiner at NASD for eight years, the spokesman said.

Carr was a senior compliance examiner in NASD's District 10 office until June 19, when, according to a complaint she filed in a New York state trial court on Wednesday, she was essentially forced to resign.
Carr is seeking a total of $20 million from NASD for allegedly "maliciously" discharging her for refusing to overlook "pay-to-play" violations in the municipal market.
